youtube.title: NASA Launched Hubble With the Wrong Mirror. A Test Had Already Shown It.
youtube.description:
The Hubble Space Telescope reached orbit in April 1990. Its first images were blurry: the main mirror was too flat at the edges by about one-fiftieth the width of a human hair. A lens in the device that guided the polishing was out of place. A second test had shown the error, but its results were overruled. In December 1993, astronauts installed corrective optics, and Hubble's images became stunning.

📂 Case File #053: Hubble's Mirror

Sources: Astronomy, "Techno-turkey: Remembering Hubble's vision troubles, 30 years on" https://www.astronomy.com/space-exploration/techno-turkey-remembering-hubbles-vision-troubles-30-years-on/ ; BBC Sky at Night, "What was wrong with Hubble's mirror, and how was it fixed?" https://skyatnightmagazine.com/space-missions/what-was-wrong-with-hubble-mirror-how-was-it-fixed
